title: 🎈 Rohan hunts the letter B at breakfast... banana or apple? #kids #alphabet #phonics
title_alts: 🏀 Rohan learns the letter B sound from a ball, a bus, a butterfly #kids #alphabet
🍌 Rohan almost calls an apple a B word... here is the easy test #kids #phonics
description_hook: One letter, one sound, four everyday things. Say the B sound out loud with Rohan and then find it at your own table.

characters.name: Rohan
characters.description: four-year-old boy, short black hair, red striped t-shirt, small gap between his front teeth

scenes.narration: Today we learn one letter. It is the letter B.
scenes.caption: आज हम एक अक्षर सीखेंगे। यह अक्षर बी है।
scenes.image_brief: A cream card printed with a large capital B and a lowercase b, propped against a blue cereal bowl on a wooden breakfast table, warm morning light from a window.

scenes.narration: B says buh. Buh, buh, B. Capital B has two round bumps.
scenes.caption: बी बोलता है ब। ब, ब, बी। बड़ी बी में दो गोल उभार हैं।
scenes.image_brief: Close view of a single wooden capital letter B block standing on a pale kitchen counter, its two round bumps facing the viewer, soft daylight.

scenes.narration: Here is a ball. Ball starts with buh. B for ball.
scenes.caption: यह एक गेंद है। बॉल शब्द ब से शुरू होता है। बी से बॉल।
scenes.image_brief: A red rubber ball sitting beside a wooden capital letter B block on a wooden breakfast table, plain cream wall behind, warm morning light.

scenes.narration: Your turn. Say buh, buh, ball out loud with me.
scenes.caption: अब तुम्हारी बारी। मेरे साथ जोर से बोलो: ब, ब, बॉल।
scenes.image_brief: An open picture book lying flat on the kitchen table showing one huge letter B with a red ball drawn beside it, bright morning light across the page.

scenes.narration: Buh, buh, B like ball. That is our B sound.
scenes.caption: ब, ब, बी जैसे बॉल। यही हमारी बी की आवाज़ है।
scenes.image_brief: A wooden capital letter B block and a red rubber ball side by side on a kitchen table, sunlight falling across both, cheerful and calm.

scenes.narration: Now look outside. A big bus rolls past. Buh, buh, bus.
scenes.caption: अब बाहर देखो। एक बड़ी बस निकल रही है। ब, ब, बस।
scenes.image_brief: A yellow school bus rolling along a quiet street seen through a kitchen window, a wooden capital letter B block on the windowsill in the foreground, morning light.

scenes.narration: A butterfly lands on the window. Butterfly begins with B too.
scenes.caption: खिड़की पर एक तितली बैठी है। बटरफ़्लाई भी बी से शुरू होता है।
scenes.image_brief: An orange butterfly resting on the outside of a kitchen window pane, a wooden capital letter B block on the sill just inside, soft daylight.

scenes.narration: Count three B words: ball, bus, butterfly. All say buh first.
scenes.caption: तीन बी शब्द गिनो: बॉल, बस, बटरफ़्लाई। सब में पहले ब है।
scenes.image_brief: Three objects lined up on a kitchen table, a red ball, a yellow toy bus and a paper butterfly, with a wooden capital letter B block in front of them, bright light.

scenes.narration: Which one starts with B, a banana or an apple? Banana.
scenes.caption: बी से कौन शुरू होता है, बनाना या सेब? बनाना।
scenes.image_brief: A yellow banana and a green apple side by side on a white plate on a kitchen table, a wooden capital letter B block beside the banana, clear daylight.

scenes.narration: We found ball, bus, butterfly and banana. Buh, buh, B like ball.
scenes.caption: हमने बॉल, बस, बटरफ़्लाई और बनाना देखे। ब, ब, बी जैसे बॉल।
scenes.image_brief: A red ball, a yellow toy bus, a paper butterfly and a banana arranged in a row on a kitchen table around a wooden capital letter B block, warm afternoon light.

title: 🌙 Kavya looks for the letter M at bedtime... milk or juice? #kids #alphabet #letterm
title_alts: ⭐ Kavya learns the letter M sound from the moon and a mango #kids #alphabet
🐒 Kavya nearly misses the M in monkey... here is the quick fix #kids #phonics
description_hook: The letter M hides in the sky, in a fruit bowl and in a glass of milk. Say the mmm sound with Kavya before lights out.

characters.name: Kavya
characters.description: five-year-old girl, long black plaited hair, yellow pyjamas with a star print, always holding a small cloth rabbit

scenes.narration: Tonight we learn one letter. It is the letter M, big and small.
scenes.caption: आज रात हम एक अक्षर सीखेंगे। यह अक्षर एम है, बड़ा और छोटा।
scenes.image_brief: A round paper card printed with a large capital M and a lowercase m resting on a bedroom windowsill at night, dark blue sky and stars outside.

scenes.narration: M says mmm. Mmm, mmm, M. Capital M has two pointy hills.
scenes.caption: एम बोलता है म। म, म, एम। बड़ी एम में दो नुकीली पहाड़ियाँ हैं।
scenes.image_brief: Close view of a wooden capital letter M block on a bedside table, its two pointed peaks clear, soft lamplight and a dark window behind it.

scenes.narration: Look up at the moon. Moon starts with mmm. M for moon.
scenes.caption: ऊपर चाँद देखो। मून शब्द म से शुरू होता है। एम से मून।
scenes.image_brief: A full white moon high in a deep blue night sky above rooftops, seen through an open bedroom window, a wooden capital letter M block on the sill.

scenes.narration: Your turn. Say mmm, mmm, moon with me, nice and slow.
scenes.caption: अब तुम्हारी बारी। मेरे साथ धीरे से बोलो: म, म, मून।
scenes.image_brief: An open bedtime picture book lying on a quilt showing one huge letter M with a small moon drawn beside it, warm lamplight.

scenes.narration: Mmm, mmm, M for moon. You found the M sound.
scenes.caption: म, म, एम जैसे मून। तुमने एम की आवाज़ पकड़ ली।
scenes.image_brief: A wooden capital letter M block on a windowsill with the bright full moon framed behind it in the night sky, calm and quiet.

scenes.narration: Now think about food. A sweet mango begins with mmm too.
scenes.caption: अब खाने की बात। मीठा मैंगो भी म से शुरू होता है।
scenes.image_brief: A ripe yellow mango on a small plate beside a wooden capital letter M block on a bedside table, warm lamplight, dark window behind.

scenes.narration: A monkey swings on a branch. Monkey starts with M as well.
scenes.caption: एक बंदर डाल पर झूल रहा है। मंकी भी एम से शुरू होता है।
scenes.image_brief: A brown monkey sitting on a thick tree branch in a leafy zoo enclosure in daylight, a wooden capital letter M block on the low wall in the foreground.

scenes.narration: Which starts with M, milk or juice? Milk. Mmm, mmm, milk.
scenes.caption: एम से कौन शुरू होता है, मिल्क या जूस? मिल्क। म, म, मिल्क।
scenes.image_brief: A glass of milk and a glass of orange juice side by side on a kitchen counter at night, a wooden capital letter M block next to the milk, soft light.

scenes.narration: Moon, mango, monkey, milk. Four M words. Mmm, mmm, M for moon.
scenes.caption: मून, मैंगो, मंकी, मिल्क। चार एम शब्द। म, म, एम जैसे मून।
scenes.image_brief: Four things in a row on a windowsill at night, a small round moon lamp, a mango, a toy monkey and a glass of milk, with a wooden capital letter M block in front, gentle light.

title: ☀️ Dhruv draws the letter S in the sand... a sock or a hat? #kids #alphabet #phonics
title_alts: 🥬 Dhruv learns the hissing S sound from the sun and a spoon #kids #alphabet
🧦 Dhruv puts a hat in the S pile... try this quick sound test #kids #phonics
description_hook: The letter S hisses like a long slow snake sound. Trace it in the sand with Dhruv, then hunt it in the sun, a spoon and a sock.

characters.name: Dhruv
characters.description: four-year-old boy, curly black hair, green dungarees, a plaster on one knee

scenes.narration: Today we learn one letter. Say hello to the letter S.
scenes.caption: आज हम एक अक्षर सीखेंगे। एस अक्षर को नमस्ते कहो।
scenes.image_brief: A smooth patch of pale sand in a sunny garden with a large letter S drawn into it, the drawing stick lying at the edge of the patch, bright midday light.

scenes.narration: S says sss. Sss, sss, S. The letter S curves like a wave.
scenes.caption: एस बोलता है स। स, स, एस। एस अक्षर लहर की तरह मुड़ता है।
scenes.image_brief: A large cut-out capital letter S standing upright in garden grass, its double curve clear against green leaves behind it, strong daylight.

scenes.narration: Here comes the sun. Sun starts with sss. S for sun.
scenes.caption: सूरज निकल आया। सन शब्द स से शुरू होता है। एस से सन।
scenes.image_brief: The bright sun low in a clear blue sky above a wooden garden fence, a wooden capital letter S block resting on the fence rail in the foreground, golden light.

scenes.narration: Your turn now. Say sss, sss, sun with me, loud and long.
scenes.caption: अब तुम्हारी बारी। मेरे साथ ज़ोर से बोलो: स, स, सन।
scenes.image_brief: An open board book propped on a sunlit garden step showing one huge letter S with a small sun drawn beside it, warm sunlight across the page.

scenes.narration: Sss, sss, S for sun. That is the S sound.
scenes.caption: स, स, एस जैसे सन। यही एस की आवाज़ है।
scenes.image_brief: A wooden capital letter S block standing on a sunlit garden step, sunlight flooding across it, warm and cheerful.

scenes.narration: A spoon in the kitchen starts with S. So does a striped sock.
scenes.caption: रसोई का स्पून एस से शुरू होता है। धारीदार सॉक भी।
scenes.image_brief: A metal spoon and a red striped sock laid side by side on a wooden garden bench, a wooden capital letter S block between them, bright afternoon light.

scenes.narration: Which one starts with S, a sock or a hat? Sock.
scenes.caption: एस से कौन शुरू होता है, सॉक या टोपी? सॉक।
scenes.image_brief: A red striped sock and a blue sun hat lying side by side on garden grass, a wooden capital letter S block next to the sock, clear daylight.

scenes.narration: Sun, spoon, sock, and now you know. Sss, sss, S for sun.
scenes.caption: सन, स्पून, सॉक — अब तुम्हें पता है। स, स, एस जैसे सन।
scenes.image_brief: A wooden garden bench holding a paper sun cut-out, a metal spoon and a red striped sock in a row, with a wooden capital letter S block in front of them, late afternoon light.

title: 🧩 Leela builds the letter T from two lines... tiger or lion? #kids #alphabet #lettert
title_alts: ✏️ Leela learns to write the letter T with one line and a hat #kids #alphabet
🐅 Leela files a lion under T... the sound test that stops it #kids #phonics
description_hook: The letter T is one straight line wearing a hat. Build it with Leela, then catch the tuh sound in a table, a tiger and a tomato.

characters.name: Leela
characters.description: five-year-old girl, short bobbed black hair, purple dress with a pocket, one blue hair clip

scenes.narration: Today we learn one letter. The letter T, big and tall.
scenes.caption: आज हम एक अक्षर सीखेंगे। अक्षर टी, बड़ा और ऊँचा।
scenes.image_brief: A sheet of white paper on a low playroom table with a large capital T and a lowercase t drawn in thick blue crayon, the crayon lying beside it, bright daylight.

scenes.narration: T says tuh. Tuh, tuh, T. Big T is one line plus a hat.
scenes.caption: टी बोलता है ट। ट, ट, टी। बड़ी टी एक लाइन और उसकी टोपी है।
scenes.image_brief: A wooden capital letter T block standing on a low playroom table, one upright line with a flat bar across the top, soft window light.

scenes.narration: Touch the table. Table starts with tuh. T for table.
scenes.caption: मेज़ को छुओ। टेबल शब्द ट से शुरू होता है। टी से टेबल।
scenes.image_brief: A low wooden playroom table seen from the side with a wooden capital letter T block resting in the middle of its top, plain pale wall behind, daylight.

scenes.narration: Now you try. Say tuh, tuh, table with me.
scenes.caption: अब तुम कोशिश करो। मेरे साथ बोलो: ट, ट, टेबल।
scenes.image_brief: An open activity book on the playroom floor showing one huge dotted letter T ready to be traced, a blue crayon lying on the page, bright daylight.

scenes.narration: Tuh, tuh, T for table. That is our T sound.
scenes.caption: ट, ट, टी जैसे टेबल। यही हमारी टी की आवाज़ है।
scenes.image_brief: A wooden capital letter T block sitting in the centre of a low wooden playroom table, clean and clear, gentle window light.

scenes.narration: A tiger in a picture book starts with T. Tuh, tuh, tiger.
scenes.caption: किताब में बना बाघ टी से शुरू होता है। ट, ट, टाइगर।
scenes.image_brief: A picture book open on the playroom rug showing a painted orange tiger standing in tall grass, a wooden capital letter T block resting on the corner of the book, warm light.

scenes.narration: Cut a tomato in half. Tomato begins with T as well.
scenes.caption: टमाटर को आधा काटो। टोमैटो भी टी से शुरू होता है।
scenes.image_brief: A red tomato cut into two halves on a white plate on the low playroom table, a wooden capital letter T block beside the plate, bright daylight.

scenes.narration: Which one starts with T, a tiger or a lion? Tiger.
scenes.caption: टी से कौन शुरू होता है, टाइगर या शेर? टाइगर।
scenes.image_brief: A picture book open flat showing a painted orange tiger on the left page and a golden lion on the right page, a wooden capital letter T block on the tiger page, soft daylight.

scenes.narration: Table, tiger, tomato. Three T words today. Tuh, tuh, T for table.
scenes.caption: टेबल, टाइगर, टोमैटो। आज तीन टी शब्द। ट, ट, टी जैसे टेबल।
scenes.image_brief: A small wooden toy table, a toy tiger and a red tomato lined up on the playroom rug, a wooden capital letter T block in front of them, late daylight.

title: 🍊 Ayesha hunts the round letter O on a picnic... owl or duck? #kids #alphabet #lettero
title_alts: 🦉 Ayesha learns the letter O from an orange, an owl, an octopus #kids #alphabet
🐚 Ayesha calls a duck an O word... try this round mouth test #kids #phonics #lettero
description_hook: The letter O is one round line with nothing straight in it. Make the round mouth with Ayesha and find O in an orange, an owl and an octopus.

characters.name: Ayesha
characters.description: four-year-old girl, black curly hair in two puffs, orange sundress, round red sunglasses pushed up on her head

scenes.narration: Today we learn one letter. It is the round letter O.
scenes.caption: आज हम एक अक्षर सीखेंगे। यह गोल अक्षर ओ है।
scenes.image_brief: A picnic blanket on park grass with a large round card showing a capital O and a lowercase o lying in the middle of it, dappled afternoon sunlight.

scenes.narration: O says oh. Oh, oh, O. O is one circle, no straight lines.
scenes.caption: ओ की आवाज़ है ओ। ओ, ओ, ओ। ओ एक गोला है, कोई सीधी लाइन नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: A wooden capital letter O ring standing upright on a picnic blanket, one unbroken circle with no straight edges, soft afternoon light on the grass.

scenes.narration: Look, an orange. Orange starts with oh. O for orange.
scenes.caption: देखो, एक संतरा। ऑरेंज शब्द ओ से शुरू होता है। ओ से ऑरेंज।
scenes.image_brief: A whole orange resting beside a wooden capital letter O ring on a picnic blanket in a park, bright afternoon light, green grass all around.

scenes.narration: Your turn. Say oh, oh, orange with a big round mouth.
scenes.caption: अब तुम्हारी बारी। मुँह गोल करके बोलो: ओ, ओ, ऑरेंज।
scenes.image_brief: An open picture book on the picnic blanket showing one huge letter O with a small orange drawn inside the circle, sunlight falling across the page.

scenes.narration: Oh, oh, O for orange. That is the O sound.
scenes.caption: ओ, ओ, ओ जैसे ऑरेंज। यही ओ की आवाज़ है।
scenes.image_brief: A wooden capital letter O ring and a whole orange side by side on a picnic blanket, warm sunlight, park grass behind them.

scenes.narration: Now look up the tree. An owl says oh first too.
scenes.caption: अब पेड़ पर देखो। उल्लू यानी आउल भी ओ से शुरू होता है।
scenes.image_brief: A brown owl perched on a thick branch of a park tree looking out calmly, a wooden capital letter O ring resting in a fork of the branch below it, dappled light.

scenes.narration: Deep in the sea, an octopus begins with O as well.
scenes.caption: गहरे समुंदर में ऑक्टोपस भी ओ से शुरू होता है।
scenes.image_brief: A picture book open on the picnic blanket showing a painted purple octopus underwater among green seaweed, a wooden capital letter O ring on the page corner, warm light.

scenes.narration: Count them: orange, owl, octopus. Three words that begin with O.
scenes.caption: गिनो: ऑरेंज, आउल, ऑक्टोपस। तीन शब्द जो ओ से शुरू होते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: An orange, a small wooden owl figure and a soft toy octopus lined up on the picnic blanket with a wooden capital letter O ring in front of them, bright light.

scenes.narration: Which one starts with O, an owl or a duck? Owl.
scenes.caption: ओ से कौन शुरू होता है, आउल या डक? आउल।
scenes.image_brief: A small wooden owl figure and a small wooden duck figure standing side by side on the picnic blanket, a wooden capital letter O ring next to the owl, clear afternoon light.

scenes.narration: We had orange, owl and octopus. Oh, oh, O for orange.
scenes.caption: हमने ऑरेंज, आउल और ऑक्टोपस देखे। ओ, ओ, ओ जैसे ऑरेंज।
scenes.image_brief: An orange, a wooden owl figure and a soft toy octopus arranged around a wooden capital letter O ring on the picnic blanket, golden late afternoon light.

title: 💧 Meher meets the letter W on a rainy day... window or door? #kids #alphabet #phonics
title_alts: 🛞 Meher learns the letter W is two V shapes standing together #kids #alphabet
🚪 Meher nearly puts a door under W... the lip trick that helps #kids #phonics
description_hook: The letter W is two V shapes holding hands, and it says wuh. Watch the rain with Meher and catch W in water, a wheel and the wind.

characters.name: Meher
characters.description: five-year-old girl, straight black hair to her chin, blue woollen jumper, one missing front tooth

scenes.narration: Today we learn one letter. Here is the letter W.
scenes.caption: आज हम एक अक्षर सीखेंगे। यह है अक्षर डब्ल्यू।
scenes.image_brief: A rain-streaked window pane with a large capital W and a lowercase w drawn in the mist on the glass, grey daylight outside, warm room inside.

scenes.narration: W says wuh. Wuh, wuh, W. Big W is two V shapes together.
scenes.caption: डब्ल्यू बोलता है व। व, व, डब्ल्यू। बड़ी डब्ल्यू दो वी से बनती है।
scenes.image_brief: A wooden capital letter W block standing on a windowsill beside a rainy window, its two V shapes clearly joined, soft grey light.

scenes.narration: Watch the water run down. Water starts with wuh. W for water.
scenes.caption: पानी बहता देखो। वॉटर शब्द व से शुरू होता है। डब्ल्यू से वॉटर।
scenes.image_brief: Rainwater running in thin streams down the outside of a window pane, a wooden capital letter W block on the sill in the foreground, cool grey daylight.

scenes.narration: Your turn. Round your lips and say wuh, wuh, water with me.
scenes.caption: अब तुम्हारी बारी। होंठ गोल करके बोलो: व, व, वॉटर।
scenes.image_brief: An open picture book propped on a windowsill showing one huge letter W with small raindrops drawn beside it, soft grey light from the rainy window.

scenes.narration: Wuh, wuh, W for water. That is our W sound.
scenes.caption: व, व, डब्ल्यू जैसे वॉटर। यही हमारी डब्ल्यू की आवाज़ है।
scenes.image_brief: A wooden capital letter W block on a windowsill with rain sliding down the glass right behind it, calm grey light.

scenes.narration: A wheel on a wagon starts with W. So does the wind.
scenes.caption: गाड़ी का व्हील डब्ल्यू से शुरू होता है। हवा यानी विंड भी।
scenes.image_brief: A red toy wagon with four black wheels standing on a hallway floor beside an open doorway where a paper pinwheel spins in the breeze, a wooden capital letter W block leaning against one wheel, dim rainy light.

scenes.narration: Which one starts with W, a window or a door? Window.
scenes.caption: डब्ल्यू से कौन शुरू होता है, विंडो या दरवाज़ा? विंडो।
scenes.image_brief: A rainy window on the left and a closed wooden front door on the right of a small hallway, a wooden capital letter W block on the windowsill, grey daylight.

scenes.narration: Water, wheel, wind, window. Four W words. Wuh, wuh, W for water.
scenes.caption: वॉटर, व्हील, विंड, विंडो। चार शब्द। व, व, डब्ल्यू जैसे वॉटर।
scenes.image_brief: A windowsill holding a glass of water, a black toy wheel and a small paper pinwheel in a row with a wooden capital letter W block in front, rain on the glass behind, soft grey light.

title: 🍎 Can you find letter A with an apple... what sound does it make? #letters
title_alts: 🍎 Trace big letter A for apple... can you say the loud sound? #letters
🍎 Look at big letter A and apple... what words start with A? #letters
description_hook: Learn the sound and shape of letter A with a shiny red apple today.

scenes.narration: Today we will learn the sound of letter A.
scenes.caption: आज हम अक्षर ए की आवाज़ सीखेंगे।
scenes.image_brief: A bright classroom reading rug with a large wooden letter A standing upright in warm morning light
